(Previous report: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/229542#issuecomment-4281471434) > > While this issue persisted, I had no choice but to keep manually clicking "Disable protection for 30 seconds" to enable AI Mode on my desktop, and ended up going through the skit of having to use AI Mode on my smartphone with my desktop in front of me for over 4 months. > How long must I continue to experience this discomfort? > > I hope this report will be the last. issue.title: Fix #236705 www.lance.com.br

comment.body:
The banner at the header seems not related to the site's contents. Can you add to Spanish list also:

```adblock
lance.com.br##header > #btn-open-chat
```

---

`div:has()` is quite generic and risky for false positives. Can you share the link where you see these elements:

```adblock
lance.com.br##iframe[title="Advertisement"]
lance.com.br##div:has(> #membrana_video)
lance.com.br##.dailymotion-player-root
```

I think the chat widgets should be in `! SECTION: Widgets - Chats` instead
